cues: As a trunk ages, the oldest wood at the centre stops conducting.

This is heartwood, or duramen: hard, durable, resistant to insects and decay, and purely mechanical.
text: As a trunk ages, the oldest wood at the centre stops conducting. Its parenchyma dies, and tannins, resins, gums and oils are deposited in its cells. It turns dark. This is heartwood, or duramen: hard, durable, resistant to insects and decay, and purely mechanical.
